newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Karrie seen offering shrs at HK$1.15 each--sources.
newsitem.headline: Karrie seen offering shrs at HK$1.15 each--sources.

text.p: Personal computer casings manufacturer Karrie Industrial Co Ltd is expected to issue 90 million shares at HK$1.15 each in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong, market sources said on Wednesday.
The issue price represents a proforma fully-diluted prospective price to earnings (P/E) multiple of 5.3 times and a weighted average P/E of 4.5 times, sources said.
Dividend yield is seen to be seven percent, net asset value per share is HK$0.741 and the total market capitalisation is about HK$414 million, they added.
The IPO is expected to run from November 29 to December 4 and trading in the shares is expected to begin on December 16.

Karrie, which also makes casings for video tape, forecast a combined profit after taxation and minority interest but before extraordinary items of not less than HK$75.4 million for the year ending March 31, 1997, sources said.

Of the HK$91.5 million net proceeds, about HK$26 million is expected to be used to upgrade and expand manufacturing facilities, about HK$49 million to repay banks borrowing and the balance will be used as working capital, sources said.
DBS Asia Capital is seen to be the sponsor of the issue, they added. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
